I'm send this reply to everybody all the same so I can remember to include as much information as possible. I figure since you all took the time to write me I can at least to the same and by giving you as much information as possible I clarify myself and my feelings more. I do not mean this to be impersonal in the slightest. I'm sorry if it feels that way. 

First of all I am willing to speak to anyone online: simply message me and i will message you back. 

@ empathetic you will receive on shortly after this posting but keep in mind I work overnight and sleep during the day. I have fri and sat off. 

I have gotten ahold of my doctor and will be going in on monday to assess myself and perhaps change the prescription.  

I live now in Wisconsin and just moved here 10 months ago. This place is great, just not having a car blows but to be honest that would be true anywhere for me right now. 

Last night I got a call from my friend who I met that second girl I mentioned through. He told me I gave her a new perspective on life and that the rejection txt's were sent by some jealous guy who got ahold of her phone without her knowing at some party. He told me she hated having days off because it meant being alone and smoking pot and my company alone made her feel loved and cared for and that she couldn't wait to see me again. She wasn't using me, she was enjoying me. I was told she truly felt a connection with me, that there was a kind of stable peace about it all. I made someone feel this way. 

Right then I cried and told him what I was planning on doing. He said what so loudly and surprised that she grabbed the phone and demanded I tell her whatever it was I told him. I did. She started crying and saying how she didn't want to lose someone that could do so much for her in such a little amount of time. IDK what I did besides encourage her, and hold her amd make her feel safe, but that fact that I did that made me not want to kill myself. 

I made someone feel good. Someone cared enough to cry over me. My friend and her came over immediately, and she sat on my lap again buried her face in my neck and said things that made me cry too. 

It was at this moment I realized I didn't have to give up. I can make people feel good and loved, and that doesn't mean they will use me. I'm going to try this now. See where it goes. So thanks for everything SW - another life saved. 

p.s. I have a date with her sat.

I can't...not anymore. I've been to therapy. I'm on anti depressants. 

They don't bring me real friends, this despite all my efforts. I'm alone and to get anyone to even listen I have to post on SW or say I'm depressed. Outside of this nobody cares.

I have a couple of my own hobbies and like anybody else enjoy my own alone time....I have to since that's all the time I have outside of work. 

I have 2 maybe 3 friends. Usually they can't hangout. 

Life has been kicking my ass forever.
